finding.claim: Unauthenticated user-controlled URL is fetched server-side by /preview with no scheme, host, or IP validation, and the response status and first 500 bytes of body are returned to the caller.

trace.note: url query parameter read into target with no validation
target passed unchanged to requests.get; redirects followed by default
status code and resp.text[:500] returned to caller (non-blind SSRF)

finding.guards_checked: No scheme check, no hostname allowlist, no private/loopback/link-local/metadata IP blocking, no auth decorator on route, no redirect restriction. ALLOWED_HOSTS (app.py:9) is defined but not applied on this route. Caveat: exposure of the service is not verifiable from the repo; if internal-only, severity drops to MEDIUM.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only host check is at app.py:24, in the /partner route (app.py:20-27), not on /preview. ALLOWED_HOSTS (app.py:9) is never applied in /preview. No auth decorator, scheme check, or IP blocking exists anywhere in app.py.
verdict.reason: The `url` query parameter is read unvalidated at app.py:15 and passed straight to requests.get at app.py:16 (redirects followed by default), and the status and first 500 bytes of the body are returned at app.py:17, with no closing guard on the /preview route. The repo does not show whether the service is internet-facing; if it is only reachable internally, severity drops to MEDIUM as the candidate noted.
